text:
name: mifos-channel

services:
  bank-channel-postgres:
    image: postgres:18.3@sha256:7e32e9833a6fb1c92c32552794cb6ed569d51b445a54907d35fc112ef39684db
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: bank_channel
      POSTGRES_USER: bank_channel
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/channel_db_password
    volumes:
      - bank_channel_pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql
    networks:
      - bank-channel-net
    secrets:
      - channel_db_password
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U bank_channel -d bank_channel"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20

  keycloak:
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.3.3@sha256:6a7217a100bd3e5de4063a27a538ef999a3c5a88c4b4ec0ffc0a642aee7b2597
    command: ["start-dev", "--http-port=8080", "--import-realm"]
    environment:
      KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME: ${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USERNAME:?KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USERNAME is required}
      KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD:?KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD is required}
      KC_HEALTH_ENABLED: "true"
      KC_METRICS_ENABLED: "true"
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:19000:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./infra/keycloak/realms:/opt/keycloak/data/import:ro
    networks:
      - bank-channel-front
      - bank-channel-net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "bash -c 'echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/8080'"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 30
      start_period: 30s

mock-clearing-service:
    build:
      context: ./services/mock-clearing-service
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    environment:
      CLEARING_CALLBACK_SECRET: ${CLEARING_CALLBACK_SECRET:?CLEARING_CALLBACK_SECRET is required}
      BANK_CHANNEL_URL: http://bank-channel-service:8080
    networks:
      - bank-channel-net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "python -c \"import urllib.request;urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:5000/health')\""]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  customer-portal:
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine@sha256:65645c7bb6a0661892a8b03b89d0743208a18dd2f3f17a54ef4b76fb8e2f2a10
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:18082:80"
    volumes:
      - ./apps/customer-portal/dist:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro
      - ./infra/gateway/customer-portal-nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
    networks:
      - bank-channel-front
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -q --spider http://localhost:80/portal/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  operations-console:
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine@sha256:65645c7bb6a0661892a8b03b89d0743208a18dd2f3f17a54ef4b76fb8e2f2a10
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:18083:80"
    volumes:
      - ./apps/operations-console/dist:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro
      - ./infra/gateway/operations-console-nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
    networks:
      - bank-channel-front
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -q --spider http://localhost:80/ops/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

gateway:
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine@sha256:65645c7bb6a0661892a8b03b89d0743208a18dd2f3f17a54ef4b76fb8e2f2a10
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:18443:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./infra/gateway/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
    networks:
      - bank-channel-front
      - bank-channel-net
    depends_on:
      bank-channel-postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      customer-portal:
        condition: service_started
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8080/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.4.2
    volumes:
      - ./infra/observability/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    networks:
      - bank-channel-net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -q --spider http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:12.1.0
    environment:
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER: ${GRAFANA_ADMIN_USERNAME:-admin}
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:?GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD is required}
      GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP: "false"
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:19001:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./infra/observability/grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    networks:
      - bank-channel-front
      - bank-channel-net
    depends_on:
      prometheus:
        condition: service_started
      loki:
        condition: service_started

loki:
    image: grafana/loki:3.5.1
    volumes:
      - ./infra/observability/loki-config.yml:/etc/loki/loki-config.yml:ro
      - loki_data:/loki
    networks:
      - bank-channel-net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -q --spider http://localhost:3100/ready || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 15

  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.130.0
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol/config.yml"]
    volumes:
      - ./infra/observability/otel-collector-config.yml:/etc/otelcol/config.yml:ro
    networks:
      - bank-channel-net
    depends_on:
      loki:
        condition: service_started

networks:
  bank-channel-front:
    driver: bridge
  bank-channel-net:
    driver: bridge
    internal: true
  mifos-core-net:
    name: mifos_isolated_internal
    external: true

volumes:
  bank_channel_pg_data: {}
  prometheus_data: {}
  grafana_data: {}
  loki_data: {}

secrets:
  channel_db_password:
    file: ./secrets/channel-db-password.txt

# create databases
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS `fineract_tenants`;
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS `fineract_default`;

# create root user and grant rights
GRANT ALL ON *.* TO 'root'@'%';

$values = [ordered]@{
  CHANNEL_DB_PASSWORD      = Get-ContainerEnvironmentValue 'mifos-channel-channel-service-1' 'CHANNEL_DB_PASSWORD'
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD        = Get-ContainerEnvironmentValue 'mifos-isolated-postgresql-1' 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD'
  FINERACT_DB_PASS         = Get-ContainerEnvironmentValue 'mifos-isolated-postgresql-1' 'FINERACT_DB_PASS'
  KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USERNAME  = Get-ContainerEnvironmentValue 'mifos-channel-keycloak-1' 'KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME'
  KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD  = Get-ContainerEnvironmentValue 'mifos-channel-keycloak-1' 'KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD'
  FINERACT_USERNAME        = Get-ContainerEnvironmentValue 'mifos-channel-channel-service-1' 'FINERACT_USERNAME'
  FINERACT_PASSWORD        = Get-ContainerEnvironmentValue 'mifos-channel-channel-service-1' 'FINERACT_PASSWORD'
  FINERACT_BASE_URL        = Get-ContainerEnvironmentValue 'mifos-channel-channel-service-1' 'FINERACT_BASE_URL'
  CLEARING_CALLBACK_SECRET = New-LocalSecret
}

$lines = @(
  '# Generated from existing running local containers. Never commit this file.'
  '# To rotate any credential, update the appropriate service and recreate it deliberately.'
)
foreach ($entry in $values.GetEnumerator()) {
  $lines += "$($entry.Key)=$($entry.Value)"
}

[System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines((Resolve-Path (Split-Path -Parent $OutputPath)).Path + [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar + (Split-Path -Leaf $OutputPath), $lines, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
Write-Output "Created local Compose environment file: $OutputPath"

pages:
  # ===== Customer Portal (15 pages) =====
  - pageId: customer.login
    routePattern: /login
    readyMarker:
      testId: login-title
    elements:
      username:
        testId: login-username
        role: textbox
        label: 用户名
      password:
        testId: login-password
        role: textbox
        label: 密码
        sensitive: true
      submit:
        testId: login-submit
        role: button
        name: 登录
      sso:
        testId: login-sso
        role: button
      error:
        testId: login-error

  - pageId: customer.dashboard
    routePattern: /dashboard
    readyMarker:
      testId: dashboard-welcome
    elements:
      refresh:
        testId: dashboard-refresh
        role: button
      logout:
        testId: dashboard-logout
        role: button
      accountCount:
        testId: dashboard-account-count
      totalBalance:
        testId: dashboard-total-balance
      activeAccounts:
        testId: dashboard-active-accounts
      error:
        testId: dashboard-error

  - pageId: customer.accounts
    routePattern: /accounts
    readyMarker:
      testId: account-list
    elements:
      transfer:
        testId: account-list-transfer
        role: button
      empty:
        testId: account-list-empty
      error:
        testId: account-list-error

- pageId: customer.account.detail
    routePattern: /accounts/:accountId
    readyMarker:
      testId: account-detail
    elements:
      back:
        testId: account-detail-back
        role: button
      balance:
        testId: account-detail-balance
      type:
        testId: account-detail-type
      status:
        testId: account-detail-status
      id:
        testId: account-detail-id
      maskedNumber:
        testId: account-detail-masked-number
      transactions:
        testId: account-detail-transactions
      noTransactions:
        testId: account-detail-no-transactions

  - pageId: customer.transfers
    routePattern: /transfers
    readyMarker:
      testId: transfer-list
    elements:
      new:
        testId: transfer-list-new
        role: button
      empty:
        testId: transfer-list-empty
      error:
        testId: transfer-list-error
      table:
        testId: transfer-list-table

  - pageId: customer.transfer.create
    routePattern: /transfers/new
    readyMarker:
      testId: transfer-form
    elements:
      sourceAccount:
        testId: transfer-source-account
        role: combobox
      beneficiary:
        testId: transfer-beneficiary
        role: combobox
      amount:
        testId: transfer-amount
        role: textbox
        label: 转账金额
      description:
        testId: transfer-description
        role: textbox
      confirm:
        testId: transfer-confirm
        role: button
        name: 确认转账
      cancel:
        testId: transfer-cancel
        role: button
      error:
        testId: transfer-error

- pageId: customer.transfer.result
    routePattern: /transfers/:paymentId
    readyMarker:
      testId: transfer-result
    elements:
      back:
        testId: transfer-result-back
        role: button
      paymentId:
        testId: transfer-result-payment-id
      status:
        testId: transfer-result-status
      amount:
        testId: transfer-result-amount
      fromAccount:
        testId: transfer-result-from-account
      toAccount:
        testId: transfer-result-to-account
      coreReference:
        testId: transfer-result-core-reference
      notFound:
        testId: transfer-result-not-found
      newTransfer:
        testId: transfer-result-new-transfer
        role: button
      dashboard:
        testId: transfer-result-dashboard
        role: button

  - pageId: customer.beneficiaries
    routePattern: /beneficiaries
    readyMarker:
      testId: beneficiary-list
    elements:
      newTransfer:
        testId: beneficiary-new-transfer
        role: button
      empty:
        testId: beneficiary-empty

  - pageId: customer.loans
    routePattern: /loans
    readyMarker:
      testId: loan-list
    elements:
      apply:
        testId: loan-list-apply
        role: button
      empty:
        testId: loan-list-empty
      error:
        testId: loan-list-error
      table:
        testId: loan-list-table

- pageId: customer.loans.apply
    routePattern: /loans/apply
    readyMarker:
      testId: loan-apply-form
    elements:
      amount:
        testId: loan-apply-amount
        role: spinbutton
      term:
        testId: loan-apply-term

        testId: loan-apply-submit

      cancel:
        testId: loan-apply-cancel

      error:
        testId: loan-apply-error

  - pageId: customer.loan.detail
    routePattern: /loans/:loanId
    readyMarker:
      testId: loan-detail
    elements:
      back:
        testId: loan-detail-back

  - pageId: customer.documents
    routePattern: /documents
    readyMarker:
      testId: document-list

  - pageId: customer.messages

      testId: message-list

- pageId: customer.profile

  - pageId: customer.security

      testId: security-settings
    elements:
      mfaEnabled:
        testId: security-mfa-enabled
      mfaDisabled:
        testId: security-mfa-disabled
      mfaMethod:
        testId: security-mfa-method

        testId: security-password-change

        testId: security-last-login

    readyMarker:
      testId: dashboard-metrics
    elements:
